csv_scope_of_work: NFTA-Metro seeks qualified vendors to submit proposals for a transportation planning, mapping, scheduling, and public outreach platform. NFTA-Metro plans to use this product to map out existing and potential bus and rail routes, understand transit demand and demographics in the region, seek public feedback on service changes, publish detour maps, and other related planning and operational tasks.
